content.application_contract: Apply only when the independent scene already declares one complete nonempty inscription, its exact character sequence, case, punctuation and line arrangement, the paint medium, the particular existing declared wooden crate, and attachment and local placement on that same carrier. Preserve all of those declarations together. Any numeric text retains its digit order and leading zeros as text, not an inferred quantity, count or measurement. Missing or ambiguous prerequisites require review. This option cannot select a new word or number, introduce an owner or carrier, substitute another material, or transfer text from a different object.
content.definition:
The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, capitalization, punctuation and line arrangement on the already declared wooden crate. For numeric text, every digit position and any declared leading zeros remain part of that exact sequence. Painted strokes stay attached to the specified face of that same crate; visible wood grain, board edges and consistent perspective locate the inscription on its wooden carrier.
이미 선언된 글자는 이미 선언된 나무 상자 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 문장부호와 줄 배열을 유지한다. 숫자 문자열에서는 각 자릿수의 순서와 선언된 앞자리 영도 그 정확한 문자열에 포함된다. 페인트 획은 같은 상자의 지정된 면에 붙어 있으며 나뭇결, 판재 경계와 일관된 원근이 나무 지지체 위 글자의 위치를 드러낸다.
content.en: declared inscription on a wooden crate

content.application_contract: Apply only when the independent scene already declares one complete nonempty inscription, its exact character sequence, case, punctuation and line arrangement, the print medium, the particular existing declared fabric banner, and attachment and local placement on that same carrier. Preserve all of those declarations together. Any numeric text retains its digit order and leading zeros as text, not an inferred quantity, count or measurement. Missing or ambiguous prerequisites require review. This option cannot select a new word or number, introduce an owner or carrier, substitute another material, or transfer text from a different object.
content.definition:
The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, capitalization, punctuation and line arrangement on the already declared fabric banner. Its printed strokes remain attached to that same textile face and follow the local cloth folds and viewing perspective. The banner boundary and unprinted cloth around the glyphs identify the bearing fabric; the full declared text stays legible on that carrier.
이미 선언된 글자는 이미 선언된 천 배너 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 문장부호와 줄 배열을 유지한다. 인쇄된 획은 같은 직물 면에 붙어 있으며 천의 국소 주름과 보는 방향의 원근을 따른다. 배너 경계와 글자 주변의 인쇄되지 않은 천이 글자가 놓인 지지체를 특정하며 선언된 전체 문구는 그 지지체 위에서 읽힌다.
content.en: declared inscription on a fabric banner
